common.session_expired: ⌛ This session timed out. Send /start to continue.
common.unauthorized: ⛔ You don't have access to that.
common.banned: ⛔ This account has been suspended. If you think that's a mistake, contact our support team.
common.error_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong on our side. The team has been alerted — please try again in a moment.
common.flood: 🐢 That's a lot of taps at once. Give it a second and try again.

help.body:
❔ PowerX Help
/start — main menu /products — open the shop /orders — your orders /wallet — your wallet /warranty — warranty & claims /support — talk to our team /language — change language
Stuck? Tap 🎧 Support and we'll take it from there.

errors.insufficient_balance: 👛 Your wallet balance doesn't cover this. Pay with USDT instead.
errors.out_of_stock: 📭 Sold out — this item just ran out of stock.
errors.product_unavailable: This product isn't in the shop anymore.
errors.max_per_user_reached: You've reached the purchase limit for this product.
errors.invalid_quantity: Send a whole number of at least 1.
errors.invalid_amount: That amount won't work. Send a positive number.
errors.refund_balance_short: That's more than the refund balance holds. Nothing was changed.
errors.frozen_balance_short: That's more than the frozen balance holds. Nothing was changed.
errors.sanctioned_balance_short: That's more than the sanctioned balance holds. Nothing was changed.
errors.user_not_found: We couldn't find your account. Send /start and try again.

support.menu:
🎧 PowerX Support Question about an order, a payment or your wallet? Open a ticket and our team will pick it up.
🆕 New Ticket — tell us what's wrong 🗂️ My Tickets — replies and status of past tickets
⏱️ We usually reply within a few hours.
support.choose_category: 🏷️ What's it about? Pick a topic:
support.ask_subject: ✍️ Describe the problem in a line or two (or send /cancel):
support.created: ✅ Ticket {ticket_number} is open. Reply right here to talk to our team — we'll get back to you soon.
support.created_undelivered: ⚠️ Ticket {ticket_number} was saved, but our support desk can't be reached right now. It isn't lost — we'll pick it up as soon as the connection is back.
support.ticket_closed: This ticket is closed. Open a new one if you still need help.
support.no_tickets: 🗂️ My Tickets No tickets yet. If something goes wrong with an order, a payment or your wallet, open one from 🎧 Support — it'll show up here with our replies.
support.tickets_title:
🗂️ My Tickets All your tickets, newest first. Tap one to read the conversation and see where it stands.
🟢 Open · 🟡 Waiting on us · 🔵 Resolved · ⚫ Closed
💬 To add to an open ticket, just reply in this chat.
support.ticket_hint_open: ✍️ Reply in this chat and your message goes straight to our team — no need to open a second ticket.
support.ticket_hint_closed: 🔒 This ticket is closed, so replies won't reach us. Open a new one from 🎧 Support if you still need a hand.
support.system_unavailable: ⚠️ Support is having a temporary problem. We're on it — please try again a little later.
support.blocked_by_ticket: You already have an open ticket ({reference}). Reply here to continue it — you can open a new one once it's closed.
support.blocked_by_warranty: Your warranty claim ({reference}) is still being reviewed. Once it's settled you can open a new ticket.
support.blocked_by_order: Your order dispute ({reference}) is still open. Type your message here and it goes straight to the team handling it. New tickets open once it's closed.
support.dispute_closed_notice:
🔒 Our team has closed your order dispute.

🎧 Support is open to you again — if anything about the refund is still unresolved, open a ticket there and we'll pick it up.

orders.manual_pending: 🛠️ Preparing your order Our team is getting it ready and will deliver it right here in this chat. You can follow it under 🧾 My Orders.
orders.empty_history: 🧾 My Orders No orders yet. Once you buy something it'll show up here — start in 🛒 Shop.
orders.history_title:
🧾 My Orders Your purchases, newest first. Tap an order to see what was in it, what you paid and how it was delivered.
🟢 Completed · 🔵 Processing · 🟡 Pending · 🔴 Cancelled
🛡️ Items with a warranty are tracked under 🛡️ Warranty.
orders.detail_history: 📜 Timeline — quote any ID below and we'll find it right away
orders.refund_parked: 💸 {amount} is in your Refund Wallet. It's kept apart from your spendable balance while our team settles it with you — it only becomes shop credit if you ask for that.
orders.refund_frozen: 🧊 {amount} is in your Frozen Wallet while our team reviews this order. It can't be spent or refunded until they release it.
orders.refund_crypto_note: 💎 This was paid on-chain, so it can't be reversed automatically. Reply in the ticket below with the BEP-20 (BSC) address you want the refund sent to.
orders.refund_ticket: 🎫 Ticket {ticket_number} is open for this refund — just reply in this chat.
orders.detail_hint: 🧾 Keep this order number handy — quoting it in 🎧 Support is the quickest way for us to find your purchase.

refunds.title: ↩️ Refunds
refunds.empty:
✅ No refunds here.

If an order is ever declined, its money shows up here — in your Refund Wallet, or in your Frozen Wallet if our team needs to review it first.
refunds.crypto_hint: 💎 You paid on-chain, so reply in the ticket with the BEP-20 address you want it sent to.
refunds.ticket: 🎫 Ticket {ticket_number} — reply there and it reaches us.
refunds.refund_row_unsanctioned_in: +{amount} released back into your Refund Wallet
refunds.footer_pending: This money is held for you, separate from your spendable balance, so it can't be spent by accident while we sort it out. Our team will either send it to you or move it into your balance — tell us in 🎧 Support if you'd prefer one or the other.
refunds.footer_frozen: Frozen money is on hold while our team reviews it. Once they release it, it moves into your Refund Wallet.
refunds.footer_sanctioned: Sanctioned money has been blocked by our team. It's still yours — once they release it, it goes back into your Refund Wallet. Ask in 🎧 Support if you want to know why.
refunds.footer_clear: Everything owed to you has been settled. Nothing is outstanding.

wallet_home.title: 👛 Wallet
wallet_home.notes: ▸ Balance is what you can spend in 🛒 Shop. ▸ Refund Wallet holds money from declined orders while our team settles it with you. ▸ Frozen Wallet holds money our team has put on hold — it can't be spent or refunded until they release it.
wallet_home.sanctioned_note: ▸ Sanctioned is Refund Wallet money our team has blocked — it's still yours, but it can't be refunded or spent until they release it.

wallet.title: 📊 Transactions
wallet.empty:
No money has moved in or out yet.

Purchases, USDT payments, refunds and anything our team adds for you will all be listed here.
wallet.footer: Newest first. If anything here looks wrong, open 🎧 Support and tell us the date and the amount.
